content.short: Martian Wallet is a self-custodial wallet for Aptos and Sui.
content.description: Martian Wallet is a self-custodial Web3 wallet for Aptos and Sui. It lets you securely store, send, and receive tokens, manage and mint NFTs, and perform peer-to-peer Twitter transactions with ease. The app is designed to be secure and user-friendly, putting your private keys under your control while delivering a smooth, intuitive experience. Martian Wallet currently supports Aptos and Sui blockchains, focusing on privacy, simplicity, and reliable access to your assets.
